title: Tests use assert(), which no-ops under NDEBUG/release builds
evidence: tests.cpp:8-18 — all 9 checks are assert(); CMakeLists.txt sets no CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE, so a Release/-DNDEBUG build would silently pass without verifying anything
suggestion: Use an explicit check that aborts regardless of NDEBUG, or pin a Debug build for the test target

title: JSON parsing/serialization and HTTP transport are hand-rolled (no external framework)
